messages:
Anna: Drafted the first narrative for the product post — focused on cost/perf story + a short benchmark explainer. dropping the doc here for quick passes: https://redwoodco.share/drafts/2460001234
Reza: Scanned it, nice framing. Can we shorten the benchmark section to 2 bullets and add one sentence on methodology? readers get nervous about numbers without the method.
Jamie: +1 on methodology. Also we need a hero quote from CTO (one liner) about reliability. Can someone ping him?
Sam: I can grab a quote. Quick question on lead routing — are we sending inbound from the post to the regular demo form or a special launch form?
Anna: Good catch. Plan is to send to a segmented launch form (utm_campaign=launch_q2, url param: ?utm_source=blog_launch) so we can tag leads and route to the webinar nurture. Here's the mapping for HubSpot: form=launch_demo -> lifecycle=lead, owner_team=webinar_ops. Thoughts?
Reza: That mapping works. Please add a fallback rule: if form owner is empty, set owner_team=sales_inbound to avoid lost leads.
Jamie: LegalBot, quick check — any compliance flags with the benchmark methodology section or the claim language?
LegalBot: quick pass: avoid superlatives like "industry-best" unless substantiated. Replace with "leading" or add footnote referencing test harness. Also add one line about customer data not used in public benchmarks.
Anna: Thanks LB. I'll update wording to "leading latency/cost profile" and add methodology footnote.
Sam: Webinar tie-in — recommend CTA above the fold: "See the 1-pager & join the launch webinar" with anchor to registration modal. We'll capture consent there.
Reza: For messaging iteration: can we include 2 short variants of the hero lede so growth can A/B test (technical vs customer ROI)? small copy blocks at the top.
Anna: Will add two variants. Also scheduling: aiming to publish Tuesday 09:00 PT so webinar can be Tues 2pm PT same day. Is that OK for comms?
Jamie: Works for GTM. Ops: are we good on assets (screens, benchmark graphs, gif) and captions?
Sam: I have the gif and graphs almost ready — sending final assets by EOD tomorrow.
Anna: Final checklist for approvals: marketing pass (today), legal pass (tomorrow morning), quote from CTO (today afternoon), assets in CDN (EOD), publish schedule confirmed (ops). Ping me directly if you need edits. :thumbsup:
Reza: Tiny nit — in the benchmark bullets include the test seed (synth workload v1, 32k context) and hardware (A100x2). otherwise good.
Anna: Noted. I'll push an updated doc and ping this thread when done. Thanks team! :rocket:
